free_tier.stated: Free Plan at USD 0: 'No credit card required', deploy as many projects and services as you like from GitHub, with services that 'automatically sleep after a period of inactivity'.

per_object_cap.stated: a single file upload is capped at 50 MB on Free; 48 hours of log retention; build machine 2C4G

retention.stated: 48 hours of logs on Free; no statement about service data

egress.terms: the documentation read states no egress allowance on the Free Plan; the 2024 changelog introduced a fee of USD 1 per 10 GB and a 10 GB free quota for serverless-plan users

limits.value: services on the Free Plan sleep after a period of inactivity; the interval is not published
10 GB of network usage free on the serverless plan, then USD 1 per 10 GB or automatic suspension
50 MB single-file upload; 0 advanced-model agent messages; no email sends

identity_cost.detail: 'No credit card required — just sign up and start deploying'

reliability_note: the sleep interval is unpublished, so 'a period of inactivity' cannot be sized; the vendor also states the Free Plan carries no SLA
confidence_note: the Free Plan page was read and states the auto-sleep and the no-card rule; the sleep duration and any compute allowance are not published on it

evidence.proved: 'Compute: manageable own servers  -  servers you purchased and own elsewhere ... you can still manage them from the Zeabur dashboard  -  1 / 3 / 10 / Unlimited', with 'Email: daily quota 0 / 100 / Unlimited' and 'Single file upload size limit 50 MB' on the free column, quoted
quoted: 'The Free Plan is Zeabur's free tier, designed for personal exploration and learning. No credit card required — just sign up and start deploying.'
quoted: 'Auto-sleep — Services on the Free Plan automatically sleep after a period of inactivity. They wake up on the next incoming request, which may cause a few seconds of cold-start latency.'
quoted feature table: 'Single file upload size limit | 50 MB' on Free, 'Log retention | 48h', 'Manageable own servers | 1'
quoted: 'Previously, the Free Plan generously provided a $5 monthly usage credit' and 'No more need to tether a payment method or manually extend your access.'

notes: The Free Plan does deploy serverless services, without a card, and they sleep. The old USD 5 monthly credit is gone. What is not established is whether the Free Plan has any compute allowance at all or is metered against a card-free quota, and the sleep interval.

session_cap.note: sleeps after an unpublished period of inactivity; wakes on the next request

network_out.ports: serverless HTTP services; no long-lived listening socket is documented

ps.max_retention: as long as a user keeps it

extras.price_arithmetic: no plan fee; usage above the free allowances is billed or suspends the service

binding_note: sleep is the first thing that matters and the vendor does not publish the timeout, so the row cannot be planned against.
